entities.name: Grace
entities.description: A medical student who survives a zombie outbreak, loses her friend and protector, and suffers severe mental trauma.
entities.quote: as a medical student grace tries helping those who are injured.but sometimes she could help.sometimes people dies infront of her.

entities.name: Rifat
entities.description: A paracommandos soldier who protected Grace during the outbreak and possessed a ring he had previously tried to gift her.
entities.quote: the soldier was none other the rifat.he called her at the end to give her that ring.may be propose her!

entities.name: Arzuna
entities.description: Grace's best friend who becomes infected and dies while saving Grace from Tareq.
entities.quote: arzuna died saving them and specially grace. grace felt so useless that time.

entities.name: Ethan
entities.description: Grace's ex-boyfriend who discovers he has powers and seeks to help her recover.
entities.quote: ethan newly knew his power.he felt bad that if only he knew about the zombie outbreak!he would surely come.

entities.name: Damian
entities.description: A friend of Ethan who uses magic to attempt to heal Grace.
entities.quote: ethan called his new friend damian back then.who knew magic.he thought if magic can do something to heal her.

entities.name: Tareq
entities.description: An infected survivor who turned into a zombie and was killed after falling from a mall building.
entities.quote: another guy,tareq turns into a zombie as he was also infected later

entities.name: defense force
entities.description: The military organization guarding the infected mall area that mistakenly fires upon Rifat.
entities.quote: infront of the mall thousand of defemse forces with gun holding to grace.but looking at her they said she was fine.

timeline_events.title: Mall Zombie Outbreak
timeline_events.description: A high-level threat incident where survivors were trapped in a mall against zombies, resulting in many casualties.
timeline_events.quote: the zombie outbreak was so powerful in that mall that even other forces never entered the mall ,and also it was a high level threat.
